story_type: two rafters stranded in a whitewater river canyon, swimmer lowered twice, helicopter hoists
hook: Their raft was gone. They were stuck at the bottom of a canyon.
narration: Two men lost their raft on a wild river, and ended up stranded at the bottom of this canyon.
It happened on the North Fork of the Smith River, in the far northwest corner of California.
Separated from the raft, they had fast whitewater on one side and steep rock on the other.
A Coast Guard Dolphin helicopter crew from Air Station Humboldt Bay flew in over the gorge.
Then the rescue swimmer went out the door and down the cable toward the river.
In a canyon this tight, the pilot cannot see below. The crewman at the door calls every move. Going down. Going right.
The swimmer reached the first man at the water's edge, and the cable brought them both up together.
[short pause] Then he went back down the cable for the second man.
outcome: The Humboldt Bay crew hoisted both men out of the Smith River canyon.
title: Stranded in a river canyon, no raft
description:
An HH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew from Coast Guard Air Station Humboldt Bay rescued two men stranded on the North Fork of the Smith River in Northern California after they were separated from their raft.
